meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Retain deployed provider missing-cURL guard and its regression in the role-scoped discovery loop.

auth.review_note: Reviewed the backend skill changes and capability boundary against unchanged account/login authorization: anonymous cart/status handles cannot read accounts, saved addresses or private owner records; browser credentials do not authorize remote tools.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed first-match rules and exact integer paise; dry-run limitations preserved.

content.review_note: Reviewed browser-local draft recovery, stale revision protection and unchanged publishing semantics against content guide.

foundation.review_note: Regenerated combined maps; no new storage boundary.

google-tags.review_note: Both configurable AI connections and PageSpeed report guidance survive the merged integrations documentation; Google reporting remains separate.

http-errors.review_note: Cross-checked the explicit Stripe namespace fallback against the existing canonical client and checkout call sites. RequestFailureService registration, CLI failure handling and exact MCP/webhook session bypass remain unchanged. The regression captures the real bootstrap before any fixture preload.

interface.review_note: Reviewed accessible preview controls and unchanged checkout UI.

mail.review_note: Reviewed shared controller change; mail behavior unchanged.

mcp-clients.review_note: PageSpeed reporting remains owner-only and does not expose a public MCP capability.

media.review_note: Reviewed locked existing row, expected revision, bounded fields and no binary replacement.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed ordered shipping preview and owner guide within cumulative release.

public-mcp.review_note: No public tool or customer quote mutation added.

remote-commerce.review_note: Preview is a hypothetical fee calculation, without persistence, tax or checkout changes.

sales-channels.review_note: Metadata editing only changes library text and preview; feed behavior unchanged.

workflow.review_note: All previous browser and provider suites preserved with shipping preview tests.
